mapper.sql: select c.metric_code, c.metric_name, c.metric_name_en, c.group_code, g.group_name, c.remark, c.source_table, c.source_field, c.uds_hour_field, c.uds_day_field, c.uds_amount_field, c.uds_baseline_field, c.update_frequency, c.single_day_only, c.chart_type, c.value_format, c.value_decimals, c.direction, c.show_as_card, c.sort_no, c.calc_type, c.left_code, c.right_code, c.agg_type, c.weight_field, c.monitorable, c.judge_type, c.min_sample_key, c.min_sample_default, c.allow_negative, c.gauge_min, c.gauge_max, c.status, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time from dashboard_metric_card c left join dashboard_metric_group g on g.group_code = c.group_code
mapper.select: order by case when c.status = '0' then 0 else 1 end, c.group_code, c.show_as_card desc, c.sort_no, c.metric_code
select count(*) from dashboard_metric_card where lower(metric_code) = lower(#{metricCode})
select group_code as "groupCode", group_name as "groupName" from dashboard_metric_group order by sort_no, group_code
select metric_code as "metricCode", page_code as "pageCode" from dashboard_page_metric order by metric_code, page_code
select metric_code as "metricCode", count(*) as "cnt" from monitor_rule where del_flag = '0' group by metric_code
select count(*) from monitor_event where metric_code = #{metricCode}
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_metric_card ( metric_code, metric_name, metric_name_en, group_code, source_table, source_field, uds_hour_field, uds_day_field, uds_amount_field, uds_baseline_field, update_frequency, single_day_only, chart_type, value_format, direction, show_as_card, sort_no, calc_type, agg_type, monitorable, allow_negative, status, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{item.metricCode}, #{item.metricName}, #{item.metricNameEn}, #{item.groupCode}, #{item.sourceTable}, #{item.sourceField}, #{item.udsHourField}, #{item.udsDayField}, #{item.udsAmountField}, #{item.udsBaselineField}, #{item.updateFrequency}, false, 'NUMBER', #{item.valueFormat}, #{item.direction}, false, (select coalesce(max(sort_no), 900) + 1 from dashboard_metric_card), 'NONE', 'SUM', false, false, '1', #{item.remark}, #{item.createBy}, current_timestamp )
mapper.update: update dashboard_metric_card set remark = #{item.remark}, source_table = #{item.sourceTable}, source_field = #{item.sourceField}, uds_hour_field = #{item.udsHourField}, uds_day_field = #{item.udsDayField}, uds_amount_field = #{item.udsAmountField}, uds_baseline_field = #{item.udsBaselineField}, update_by = #{item.updateBy}, update_time = current_timestamp where metric_code = #{item.metricCode}

update dashboard_metric_card set metric_name = #{item.metricName}, metric_name_en = #{item.metricNameEn}, group_code = #{item.groupCode}, value_format = #{item.valueFormat}, direction = #{item.direction}, update_frequency = #{item.updateFrequency}, update_by = #{item.updateBy}, update_time = current_timestamp where metric_code = #{item.metricCode} and status = '1'
mapper.delete: delete from dashboard_metric_card where metric_code = #{metricCode} and status = '1'
